opener_concept: Saving for a £20 hoodie: £8 now plus £4 a week. Fewest whole weeks (answer 3) is a common-sense range problem; the reveal names 8 + 4w >= 20 as an inequality and checks the boundary (8 + 4*3 = 20 exactly), foreshadowing the sign-flip rule.
